Wie viel Raum und Hall erzeugt wird – me: How much room and reverb is generated – more makes the room larger and more reverberant, less makes it drier. Middle = preset, ±12 dB; fully left turns the reverb off (early reflections stay quiet).

Gegenphasige und sehr hart gepannte Ante: Out-of-phase and hard-panned components are moved to the rear – quieter at the front, louder at the back, dry and without delay. Normal music stays at the front. The preset adds its own weighting (Gentle less, Live more).
Was laut im Vordergrund steht, auf beide: Anything loud in the foreground that is about equally loud on both sides but barely correlated – wide vocal doubles, Leslie organ, wide synths – moves dry and bright towards the rear on the same side. Quiet reverb stays in the room.
Die Front wird per M/S zu L/C/R dekodier: The front is decoded to L/C/R via M/S: M = (L+R)/2 goes to the centre with sin and stays in L/R with cos (the power of a phantom centre stays the same). Middle = classic matrix (centre M at 0 dB, front M at −3 dB), left = L/R only, right = the whole middle in the centre channel. You set bass management (crossover frequency 80/100/120 Hz, Linkwitz-Riley 24 dB/oct., LFE level) in the Space menu on the player bar.
